Your tasks include: - Setting up and operating machines - Beading, cutting and bending sheet metal - Checking products for size, quantity and damage - Working with tape measure and, when needed, an angle gauge - Moving products to the next workstation - Packing products and preparing them for storage - Identifying small machine problems and solving them when possible - Carrying out small daily maintenance tasks - Keeping your workplace clean, tidy and safe The work can be repetitive. This job is therefore a good fit for someone who enjoys practical production work and does not mind doing the same tasks often. When needed, you may also use a forklift to move materials within the production area.  What are the working hours? You work in a 2-shift system: - From 06:00 - 14:00 - From 14:00 - 22:00  Who are you?  - You are motivated and enjoy practical production work - You do not mind repetitive work - You work accurately and pay attention to quality - You are willing to work in 2 shifts - You speak English at minimum B2 level - Experience in production or working with machines is a plus  What do you get? At Zinkunie, you will earn a gross hourly wage between €16.55 and €20.23, depending on your experience. Your salary is paid out weekly on Friday. And that's not all. - 20% shift allowance on top of you...
